### Info

A compact hard drive cage for 3.5&#34; drives that will fit most cases. Can be mounted to 120mm and 140mm fan slots, not single fan mount points. Different models from 1 to 6 drive bays so you can choose which one best fits your needs or upgrade plans. Recommended to install it with rubber washers to reduce the noise from the drives.

### Printing

Recommended to print using ABS or another material that can handle some heat.

 

Print the caddy flat with support for the rails, handle and back edge. You can also use the pre supported file.
Cage can be printed without support in the orientation provided.

### Sizes

Footprint:
Body - 117mm (w) x 154mm (d)
Mounting feet - 131,4 mm (w)

Height:
6 Bay - 198mm
5 Bay - 166mm
4 Bay - 134mm
3 Bay - 102mm
2 Bay - 70mm
1 Bay - 38mm

### Hardware

* 4-6x #6-32 screw (for mounting the HDD to the caddy)
* 1-2x M3 screw (optional for securing the caddy to the cage)
* 1-2x M3 x 4mm threaded insert (optional for securing the caddy to the cage)
* 4x M4 x 14mm bolt (for mounting the cage to case)
* 4x M4 nut
* 4x Rubber washer (recommended)

Druckeinstellungen:
- Druckprofil: All Sizes PETG
- Schichthöhe: 0.2 mm
- Wandlinien: 2
- Infill: 15%
- Filament: PETG (#545454)
